ruleDefinitions.name: Powershell Store File In Alternate Data Stream
ruleDefinitions.description: Storing files in Alternate Data Stream (ADS) similar to Astaroth malware. Note: Unmapped fields: ScriptBlockText

sequences.query: (ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Start\\-Process.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-FilePath\\ \\"\\$env\\:comspec\\"\\ .*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-ArgumentList\\ .*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\>.*"))
